reason: Primary user-facing purpose is automated maintenance of dsh-ocr/llm-deepseek compatibility: on harness boot it detects whether expected OCR seam and OCR library fixes were removed by upgrades and reapplies them, with exact-anchor matching and a verification step that can roll back changes if loading fails.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 启动时自动维护 OCR 相关修复补丁，被升级清除的适配或修正会在检测后被恢复，并在验证失败时回滚。
summaries.en: This plugin maintains DeepSeek Harness OCR-related fixes automatically at startup, reapplying known patches removed by upgrades and rolling back changes if the post-patch verification step fails.

capabilities: Checks for missing OCR-related patches during DSH startup
Rewrites targeted dependency files using anchored string replacements
Verifies patched modules in a child process and rolls back on failure
